# Packed V100 job: timing of the generated adjoint (two trees), parity of the changed kernels (the new tree), the acc[1] register probe.
# Each tree runs in its own child process. A hung child is killed at its own limit, and the job still prints one JSON line.
using Base64, JSON3
const PAYLOAD_B64 = ""
const DT0 = time()
root = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
write(joinpath(root, "p.tgz"), base64decode(PAYLOAD_B64))
run(`tar -xzf $(joinpath(root, "p.tgz")) -C $root`)
cfg = JSON3.read(read(joinpath(root, "cfg.json"), String))
out = joinpath(root, "out"); mkpath(out)
status = Dict{String,Any}()
function runchild(label, parts, budget, hard)
    cmd = `$(Base.julia_cmd()) --startup-file=no $(joinpath(root, "child.jl")) $root $label $out $parts $budget`
    p = run(pipeline(cmd; stdout = joinpath(out, "child_$(label).out"), stderr = joinpath(out, "child_$(label).err")), wait = false)
    t0 = time(); killed = false
    while process_running(p)
        if time() - t0 > hard
            killed = true
            kill(p, Base.SIGTERM); sleep(15)
            process_running(p) && kill(p, Base.SIGKILL)
            break
        end
        sleep(5)
    end
    try wait(p) catch end
    status[label] = Dict("seconds" => round(time() - t0, digits = 1), "exit" => p.exitcode, "killed_at_limit" => killed)
    println(stderr, "child $label done after ", round(time() - t0), " s, exit ", p.exitcode, " killed ", killed)
end
for c in cfg["children"]
    runchild(String(c["label"]), String(c["parts"]), Float64(c["budget"]), Float64(c["hard"]))
end
rd(f) = isfile(f) ? String.(filter(!isempty, split(read(f, String), '\n'))) : String[]
tail(f, n) = isfile(f) ? last(read(f, String), min(n, filesize(f))) : ""
res = Dict{String,Any}("status" => status, "total_s" => round(time() - DT0, digits = 1))
for lab in ("A", "B")
    res["notes_$lab"] = rd(joinpath(out, "$(lab)_notes.txt"))
    res["T_times_$lab"] = rd(joinpath(out, "$(lab)_T.times"))
    res["child_err_tail_$lab"] = tail(joinpath(out, "child_$(lab).err"), 3000)
end
for part in ("P1", "P2"); res["lines_$part"] = rd(joinpath(out, "B_$(part).lines")); end
res["T_lines_A"] = rd(joinpath(out, "A_T.lines")); res["T_lines_B"] = rd(joinpath(out, "B_T.lines"))
pj = joinpath(out, "B_probe.json"); res["probe"] = isfile(pj) ? JSON3.read(read(pj, String)) : nothing
println(JSON3.write(res))
